title: Length bound for the reduced value
statement: For every bit string $D$, the word representing the value reduced modulo the key extracted from $D$ has length at most the length of the raw input extracted from $D$.
caveat: The statement relies on nested encoded fields and value computations whose full constructions are not described in the supplied informal definitions.
